tours.description:
Sailing/Snorkel Adventure to Turtle Cove at Little Buck Island

“An Adventurous Outing”

Departure

Tours depart daily at 1pm and returns at 4pm
Departure time is local time, aka AST (Atlantic Standard Time zone).
Check-in 30 minutes prior to departure.

Includes

Sanitized snorkel gear with floatation
Snacks and all beverages
Alcohol served after in-water activities are concluded

About the Adventure:

Board a 54' sailing catamaran for an exhilarating sail to the uninhabited Buck Island National Wildlife Refuge's Turtle Cove.
Experience a fun-filled, marine life adventure.
Choose to swim and snorkel in the warm waters of the Caribbean Sea, tan on the special deck of the catamaran, or relax in the shaded cabin area.

What You'll See:

Visit coral reefs with an abundance of tropical fish.
Watch resident Green Sea Turtles in their natural habitat.

Ideal For:

Singles, couples, groups, friends, families

Parking:

Parking at the Cove is free.
Guests arriving by taxi should proceed directly to the dock.
Guests arriving by private vehicle must stop at the security gate checkpoint before proceeding to the designated parking area

tours.name: Sunset/Night Snorkel
tours.description:
Watch the Sunset, and explore the ocean as the daylight fades to night.
Rates

Rates may vary around the holiday dates.

Duration

2.5 Hours

About

Watch the gorgeous sunset on the water as you get your gear and flashlights ready for snorkeling in the beautiful waters around St. Thomas at night! Once the sun goes down, you will enjoy a guided snorkel tour and discover the best of St. Thomas' night life! Whether it's your first time exploring with us or your 100th, there will always be something new to see (especially at night)!

What to Bring

We provide the snorkel gear, flashlights, bottled water…most everything is provided, just bring your swimwear, towels, cash gratuity for the boat crew (island standard is 20%), and your smiles. We'll handle the rest.

Please be aware we need to have minimum 5 snorkelers to run a night boat trip. We also may call off a night trip due to any unsafe conditions. In the unlikely event we call off the trip, we will inform you ASAP, offer to reschedule or refund your full booking charge.

Cancellations

highlights: Unique Experience: Come kayak with us at night to experience the best of what St. Thomas has to offer.
Expert Guides: Our knowledgeable guides will give a quick "How to Kayak" instruction, then lead the tour, sharing insights about the local wildlife, ecology, and history of the island.
Scenic Views: Take in the breathtaking views of the tropical landscape under the stars, creating a picturesque backdrop for your adventure.

Wildlife Watching: Keep an eye out for nocturnal wildlife as you paddle quietly through the waters, with the chance to see tarpon, stingray, and possibly even some endangered species like our local sea turtles.

Perfect for All Levels: Designed to be accessible and enjoyable for all ages and skill levels, our stable kayaks ensure a safe and enjoyable experience for families, children, seniors, non-swimmers, and both beginner and advanced kayakers.

Come snorkeling with us aboard Reef Surfari, our new 47’ power catamaran, through the Virgin Islands National Park around St. John in the beautiful USVI. We depart daily from the dock behind our retail store Ocean Surfari in Red Hook on St Thomas at 9:30 and head to Cruz Bay to pick up our St John guests from the beach in front of our retail store Ocean Surfari at 10:00. From there we head to two different snorkel spots to look for sea turtles, beautiful corals and a plethora of tropical fish. We will have an open bar with rum punch, painkillers, cold beers, sodas and water as well as light snacks for your refreshment after snorkeling. Alcohol is served beginning at the second snorkel spot once you are finished swimming. After snorkeling, we will return to St. John to drop off our guests at 12:30 and then back to St Thomas at 1:00.

Get your gear and flashlights ready while you watch the beautiful sunset on the water and then go diving in the amazing waters around St. Thomas at night! Whether it's your first time diving with us or your 100th, there will always be something new to see (especially at night)!

We provide the gear, flashlights, bottled water…most everything is provided, just bring your certification card, swimwear, towels, cash gratuity for the boat crew, and your smiles. We'll handle the rest.

Experience the enchanting and eerie side of Charlotte Amalie on our #1 rated two-hour nighttime walking tour. As dusk descends, we explore the town’s haunted history, folklore, and lingering spirits. Led by knowledgeable local guides well-versed in local lore, you’ll journey through cobblestone streets and hidden courtyards where ghostly tales and island legends come alive. Use real ghost-hunting equipment to detect supernatural energy as you uncover the town’s mysterious past. Midway, enjoy a restroom break and stop at a haunted bar for cocktails available for purchase. This blend of history, mystery, and the paranormal promises chills, charm, and perhaps a few ghostly goosebumps along the way.

tours.name: Night Kayak Tour
tours.description:
Kayak through the beautiful mangroves and spot wildlife in the evening!

Check off another item from your bucket list with this adventure of a lifetime!

This tour begins when you board your two-person kayak and paddle through the shallow waters of the Mangrove Lagoon. Wind your way through the tunneled waterways while the sun dips toward the horizon. Your guide will point out wildlife including birds flocking to their nests. As the sun continues to set, look up and see the star-filled skies. Peer into the waters below your kayak and learn about the marine life that is supported by this vital mangrove ecosystem. This night kayak tour is an enchanting experience not to be missed.

What's included

All equipment, including tandem kayaks, paddles, and personal floatation devices are provided.

What to Bring

You may wish to bring a waterproof camera and gratuity for you

tours.description:
Dive into a guided snorkeling journey, where you'll glide alongside graceful sea turtles in their pristine Caribbean sanctuary. Beneath the crystal-clear turquoise waters, explore vibrant sea grass beds teeming with an array of marine wonders, including sea turtles, stingrays, and playful pufferfish. After your aquatic adventure, indulge in 30 minutes of leisurely beachcombing, basking in the sun's warm embrace, strolling along the tropical shoreline in search of precious shells, and seizing picture-perfect moments. Join us for this extraordinary opportunity to create lasting memories and experience the enchantment of the underwater realm.

If you are providing your own transportation, we will give you the location closer to the date based on weather to give you the best beach option available, but normally this tour takes place at Brewers Bay Beach, a 5-10 min drive from the airport on St. Thomas.

tours.name: Sunset Kayak Tour – Golden Hour Paddle from Cruz Bay, St. John
tours.description:
Paddle through the golden light of early evening along St. John’s calm western shoreline on this peaceful 1.5-hour guided kayak tour. Launch from Cruz Bay Beach and glide past Gallows Point with views of Frank Bay and St. Thomas in the distance. Your CPR-certified local guide will share fun facts about the island’s history, wildlife, and coastal ecology. This tour is perfect for couples, families, and photographers looking to capture the pastel skies and shimmering reflections of golden hour. Finish your experience feeling relaxed and refreshed—ask your guide about local happy hour deals after the tour! All gear included; no experience necessary.

tours.name: Discover Scuba Diving
tours.description:
Get a crash course in Scuba Diving without making a huge commitment. Just TRY it and see if you LIKE it!
Duration of entire trip

Approximately 3.5 to 4 Hours

About

Have you ever wanted to give Scuba Diving a try? With the discover scuba diving adventure, you can do just that under the supervision and guidance of one of our highly capable certified Instructors. Before your dive day, complete a quick 15 minute Discover Scuba prep course online. On your scheduled day, you will check-in at Saga Haven Marina about 30 minutes early to get fitted for your gear. You and your instructor will spend time on the boat reviewing what you've learned in your online learning and practicing a couple safety skills. Once you arrive at the calm dive site area, you will practice the safety skills in the water and feel what it's like to breath underwater. Once you're comfortable, you will head out for a real dive with your instructor by your side.

All Discover Scuba Diving participants must be able to swim comfortably in an open water environment without assistance.

All Discover Scuba Diving participants must complete a standard Diver Medical Questionnaire as part of their prep course. Important to note that some conditions (some yes answers on the questionnaire) require pre-approval by physician.

tours.description:
About:

Glass Bottom Kayak Tour of Salt River Bay and Mangroves

Go eco-kayaking into the depths of nature and history with a glass bottom kayak tour of Salt River Bay National Park and Ecological Preserve. This excursion will feature a paddling tour of the multiple bays within the park boundaries, emphasizing the dense mangroves and crystal waters in our glass bottom kayaks. Become immersed into the rich nature and history of Salt River Bay and learn about the different types of mangrove forest while spying snowy egrets, pelicans, and sunbathing iguanas.

tours.name: Snorkeling Adventures
tours.description:
Guided Caribbean Snorkel Adventure!
Duration

3 to 4 Hours depending on which sites we visit
Check-in 30 minutes before excursion time.

About

The crystal clear waters of the Caribbean are filled with an abundance of beautiful marine life and we want to show it all to you! You're guaranteed to see colorful corals and sea fans and numerous species of tropical fish while in the company of your knowledgeable and friendly in-water guide. Depending on the day, you may also see rays, turtles, or even a shipwreck!

Your half-day snorkel adventure includes stops at two different snorkeling sites (exact itinerary varies based upon conditions and other factors). Our 42-foot boat caters to small groups to ensure personal attention for novice snorkelers and the best sightings for everyone.

**All guests must be able to swim comfortably in an open water environment without assistance. **

Cost

The price includes a full set of equipment (mask, snorkel, and fins), water and soft drinks on the boat, snacks, and pirate punch on the way back to the dock. The only thing not included is customary gratuity for the boat crew (recommend 20%). excursion rates may vary on holiday dates.

What to Bring

Your swimwear, reef safe sun protection (no spray), towel

Check in for the yacht is at 9:00am on the day of your booking, and checkout will be at 1:00 pm on the last day of your charter. You must be 18 or older and have a valid driver's license to book a yacht charter.

After checking in, guests board for a truly extraordinary day. A light continental style breakfast is served as we cruise on the North Shore of St. John to enjoy a morning snorkel off one of the many coral reefs surrounding the island. After the snorkel stop, the boat continues on to Great Harbor to clear into customs.

After customs we make our way to White Bay, just a few minutes away and home to the Soggy Dollar Bar and one of the finest beaches on the planet!

tours.description:
An unsinkable legend that’s perfect for entertaining, this roomy, meticulously maintained center console can accommodate guests with plenty of room to spare. There’s also lots of dry space for gear, making this acclaimed boat attractive to family-minded boaters.

The Whaler’s roomy forward area features both a large sunpad for sunbathing and a V-seating area with a table that raises and lowers with the touch of the button, transforming the area into a lounge. If you prefer more sun protection, an electric shade from the aft end of the hardtop gives you the option of extra shade. For your added comfort, there are fresh water sinks and on-deck showers with hot water.

The 370 cruises at 35 mph and tops out at over 50 mph powered by three 300-hp Mercury Verado four-stroke outboards. Electronics include a Fusion/JL Audio sound system with XM and Bluetooth Radio, dual Garmin 16” monitors, autopilot, VHF radio, EPRIB, 110V/12V power receptacles and multi-color LED lighting for evening cruising.

tours.name: Private VanDutch 40' Charter

We are pleased to introduce the newest addition to the fleet, Lady Luxe, VanDutch 40.

The brand defining VanDutch 40, the original power boat model, remains as striking and inspiring today as the day it was launched. Frank Mulder’s legendary design combines style with performance to create a boat for all your needs, with ample space to entertain, power to reach speeds of up to 40 knots and luxurious features to ensure your ride is comfortable, including a semi-automatic Bimini top. The queen-size V-cabin with galley station turns this versatile day boat into an overnight cruiser, opening up a world of options to your boating experience.

Join us on our luxury sailing catamaran for a snorkel adventure and lunch at a floating taco bar! Enjoy a morning snorkel off one of the many coral reefs surrounding St. John. tours.name: Discover The Baths of Virgin Gorda - British Virgin Islands
tours.description:
Enjoy a full-day adventure aboard the power catamaran Jost Boat to The Baths of Virgin Gorda where you will explore and relax in the world famous "Baths". We will also enjoy lunch from Top of The Baths Restaurant before departing Virgin Gorda for a refreshing snorkel stop at The Treasure Caves of Norman Island.

What's included

Sanitized snorkel gear with floatation, towels, freshwater showers, continental breakfast, lunch and all beverages

Itinerary

We start the day with continental breakfast as we cruise to The World Famous Baths of Virgin Gorda. Formed over millions of years, the Batholiths or "Baths" are a series of interconnecting boulder formations creating unique grottos to wander through, and crystal clear waters to explore and relax in. They are truly one of the wonders of the Caribbean, and a must see.

Excited for a lunch at the "Baths"? Well look no farther than Top of the Baths. They will provide an exceptional lunch on your exceptional trip.

After lunch, we head to the Treasure Caves of Norman Island for some amazing snorkeling. Legend has it that this is the setting of Robert Louis Stevenson's book 'Treasure Island.' The Caves are a gorgeous snorkel with friendly fish and three different caves to snorkel through and explore.

About

Paddleboard like never before with our completely transparent SUPs. Take the island’s favorite pastime up to a whole new level. Explore and discover the rich and diverse Salt River Bay National Historical Park and Ecological Preserve with unlimited visibility beneath your feet. Take a self-guided tour of the multiple bays comprising the national park all at your own pace. Paddle amongst the endangered mangrove trees or cut across the clear Caribbean waters while spotting the wildlife, birdwatching, and marine life all abundant in the area. Our self-guided tour is available all day long, so set your own start time, duration, and pace. Set out for a beautiful eco tour, race the bay for some exercise, or find a quite spot for some yoga.

Our sea thru SUPs offer a unique way to paddle the National Park, but the unique transparent design is less forgiving for beginner and novice paddlers. We recommend beginner paddlers start with our other SUP options to gain a solid level of skill and comfort before jumping on the less forgiving sea thru SUPs.

*Please remember our sea thru SUPs cannot be taken ashore or to any beaches as they are damaged when ran aground. Check out our other SUP options for beach friendly boards.

Enjoy an exclusive tasting of Botany Bay Rum and Havensight Rum, two locally inspired blends that reflect the bold, authentic flavors of the Virgin Islands. Learn how centuries of sugarcane cultivation and rum distilling shaped the island’s economy and cultural identity. Meet -up at I Love St. Thomas, a beloved family-owned shop in historic Downtown Charlotte Amalie, home to the island’s largest selection of gifts, souvenirs, and locally made treasures.

Guests receive a complimentary full-size cocktail or non-alcoholic refreshment, followed by a self-guided stroll using our curated map through downtown’s scenic streets—filled with history, colorful shops, and local artisans.

Perfect for rum lovers, history buffs, and first-time visitors, this tour offers a spirited blend of flavor, storytelling, and island hospitality.

tours.name: LATE NIGHT Bioluminescent Kayak Trip
tours.description:
Hours

About

Bioluminescence is a natural phenomenon wherein living organisms emitting light, and several species are on display year round in Salt River Bay: Dinoflagellates (single-cell plankton), ctenaphores (AKA comb jellies), Bermuda Fireworms to name a few. On this tour, we kayak 1km east to Bio Bay to observe the "super glow" Dinoflagellate habitat. You will also explore other nearby spots searching for other bioluminescent species.

tours.name: Private Luxury Excursions on Magic Moments
tours.description:
We welcome you to the ‘Magic Moments’ that will bring memories that will last a lifetime. Explore the most beautiful destinations of St. Thomas, St. John & the British Virgin Islands. We can customize your day for you. You may choose to swim and snorkel in the warm waters of the Caribbean Sea, tan on the special deck of the yacht, or relax in the shaded cockpit area. We can also visit pristine beaches and coral reefs with an abundance of tropical fish. These customized itineraries may include trips within the US Virgin Islands only or exploring the British Virgin Islands. A unique stop could be to ‘the Baths’ on Virgin Gorda. The Baths are house-sized granite boulders that create unique geologic formations on this tropical beach, creating a maze of white sand and tidal pools.

Magic Moments Luxury Yachts are 45'6" l.o.a. Sea Rays designed for the most discriminating traveler. The yachts feature generous cockpit space for lounging and dining, cushioned tanning areas and elegantly appointed, air conditioned interiors with wood finish and fine upholstery. Generous staterooms feature full bathrooms with elegant vanities and showers. Twin diesel engines ensure a quiet and comfortable ride. The yachts' spaciousness allows us to focus on service and attention to detail. Magic Moments is designed to impress. We are more than an excursion.

This is destined to be the most Magical time of your vacation.

Call to book!

tours.name: Private Full Day Sail in the BVI
tours.description: Come aboard the Blue Dream as we take off for Jost Van Dyke, BVI, being the largest monohull daysail yacht in the Virgin Islands we can make it there in no time, giving you a full day at Jost Van Dyke. John National Park on our way to the BVI with premium quality snorkel gear and instruction provided. Experience the famous Soggy Dollar and their famous "pain killer," or stay on board and enjoy ours!

tours.name: Nature and Sightseeing Tour at Phantasea Tropical Botanical Garden
tours.description: Thomas the Garden is a dynamic place where those with a passion for horticulture, a love for nature, and families seeking fun can gather to reconnect with their humanity. Over 1000 orchids growing naturally in the landscape, hundreds of bromeliads, palms, succulents and other exotic tropical plants.

tours.name: Rainbow Beach with Round-trip Transportation in St. Croix (Self Guided Tour)
tours.description: Rainbow beach is popular for families or anyone who wants to spend a perfect getaway. Its white sand and perfect water is best for swimming, snorkeling or just enjoying and relaxing in the calm, clear water. Rainbow Beach is located up Route 63 and is accessible via an entrance in a local restaurants.
